info.name: OpenRegister API: health, URN, permissions and GDPR/AVG
info.description: Covers GenericHealth, urn, scopes, permissions, permissionsAudit, derivedGrants, verwerkingsactiviteiten, processingPurpose, auditSink, contentReport, dsar, dataSubjectRequest, erasurePreview, principalReach, subjectExport, configurationDeployment, dsarCase and processingLog: success, unknown-id, invalid-input and non-admin access cases for each route. Seeds its own data: `00 setup` creates a register, schema, object, a plain user and a content reviewer (via OCS); `99 teardown` deletes them. Depends on no other collection.
